verdict.rationale: The evidence shows general run monitoring: pipeline health, logs and failure diagnosis via the dltHub CLI and Web UI, plus run observation and scheduling. That is an adjacent capability. Nothing documents per-destination-table freshness tracking or alerts when a pipeline misses its expected cadence, so the story is unevidenced.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I can tell how fresh each destination table is and get warned when a pipeline misses its expected cadence

citations.quote: Use the dltHub CLI and the Web UI at app.dlthub.com to monitor pipeline health, inspect logs, and diagnose failures.
Schedule, refresh, backfill, and observe runs with a familiar decorator-based Python API.
